title: wood
description: The Wood Between the Worlds: the universal (initial) mediating nucleus for a family of worlds — (Wd, {pools P_i}, {portals φ_i}) through which every other mediator factors uniquely up to isotropy. The canonical inter-world fabric. Its existence is postulated, not constructed (open: whether voidmath's settled fold-tower grounds it). A mediating-nucleus refined by the universal property.

universal.description: initial (terminal, in the source's orientation) in the category of mediators for the family: a unique-up-to-isotropy factorization from every mediator
